Notes.Text:
This update for cups-filters fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-95511: `lpadmin` user can escalate privileges to `root` via printers that uses a privileged serial backend
  (bsc#1282291).

Vulnerabilities.Description: Not a vulnerability. Creating a serial queue that overwrites cups-files.conf requires membership in SystemGroups (lpadmin), which is an opt-in cupsd admin role granted by a superuser. No privilege boundary is crossed.
